headline: Nahar Capital submits September 2026 demat report
hook: September demat filing submitted to exchange
summary: Nahar Capital and Financial Services Limited has submitted its demat report for the month of September, 2026 to the exchange. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing submitted by the company. Retail investors need not take any action based on this procedural update. The filing contains no financial results, corporate actions, or price-sensitive information.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your investments.
